name: Ethic QR Scanner
tagline: An offline QR and barcode scanner that never opens links automatically.
blurb: Ethic QR Scanner reads QR codes and common barcodes using the device camera.
description:
Ethic QR Scanner reads QR codes and common barcodes using the device camera.

Decoded content remains on the device. The app has no account, tracking,
advertising or network permission.

Links are displayed for review and require a separate choice before a browser
can be opened. The app does not claim to judge whether a link is safe.

install.label: F-Droid
install.note: Adds F-Droid as an update source, so you keep getting updates.
